Seven Thousand Years of History & Prophecy
From Creation (1 AM · 3925 BC) to the end of the seventh millennium · Bible · Dead Sea Scrolls & Essenes · Church · World · 538 prophecies
Each millennium is one "day" of equal width; inside a day, busier centuries get more room. Dates follow Scripture and Ken Johnson's chronology (AM = AD + 3925). "c." = approximate.

Sources: Scripture (KJV); Ken Johnson, Ancient Prophecies Revealed (#1–485) and his chronology; the Dead Sea Scrolls; standard histories. Events: Bible 30 of 112 labelled · Dead Sea Scrolls & Essenes 6 of 38 labelled · Church 26 of 124 labelled · World 47 of 265 labelled (the rest are dots; every event is in the app).
